localisation.arrierePlanAide: Keeps guiding you when the screen is off or the app is no longer in the foreground. Your location is only recorded during a trip, solely to guide you, and is not kept.

notifications.guidageAide: Shows the next instruction in the notification bar during a trip.
notifications.meteoAide: Warns you about a shower, a thunderstorm, hail or black ice during a trip.
notifications.recapAide: A summary of your trips, kilometres and badges at the start of each month, and at the start of the year.
notifications.bloqueesTexte: Allow notifications for Sécu'Cycle in your phone settings.
notifications.bloqueesBandeau: Notifications are blocked by your phone. Tap to open the settings.
notifications.reglageErreur: We could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.

zoneDanger.avertissement: Deleting permanently erases your account and the data attached to it.
